\[

\]

\[
(y - 1)^{18} = \sum_{k=0}^{18} \binom{18}{k} y^k (-1)^{18 - k}
\]

\[
1 - (y - 1)^{18} = 1 - \sum_{k=0}^{18} \binom{18}{k} y^k (-1)^{18 - k}
\]

\[

\]

\[
P(y - 1) = - \sum_{k=1}^{18} \binom{18}{k} (-1)^{18 - k} y^{k - 1}
\]

Rewriting the summation index \(m = k - 1\):
\[
